title: Electromagnetic-Damping-Research: Data, firmware, hardware and analysis code
description: Raw DAQ records, phone-video tracks with true frame times, DAQ firmware and schematics, and the analysis code that reproduces every number, table and figure in the paper 'Coil-circuit impedance and sampling-clock errors in a microcontroller-based electromagnetic damping experiment' (Malik, Kumar and Farooq, 2026; earlier preprint version: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23449036). Run Code/Analysis/run_all.py. Code and hardware are released under the MIT licence; the data are released under CC BY 4.0.
